entities.name: Jeronimo de la Ossa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jerónimo de la Ossa was a Panamanian romantic poet, lyricist, and diplomat. He wrote the lyrics of the national anthem of Panama Himno Istmeño. His brother was Jose Francisco de la Ossa, the mayor of Panama City.
